demos.title: Merxus Real Estate — Bilingual Call Demo
demos.summary: A Spanish-speaking buyer asks about a listing, requests a showing, and switches to English for the confirmation details.

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Thank you for calling Horizon Realty. I'm the Merxus AI assistant. How may I help you today?
transcript.englishTranslation: Thank you for calling Horizon Realty. I'm the Merxus AI assistant. How may I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.originalText: Hola, vi la casa de tres recámaras en la Avenida Magnolia. ¿Todavía está disponible?
transcript.englishTranslation: Hello, I saw the three-bedroom house on Magnolia Avenue. Is it still available?

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Sí, sigue disponible. Puedo solicitar una visita. ¿Qué día y hora le convienen?
transcript.englishTranslation: Yes, it is still available. I can request a showing. What day and time work for you?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.originalText: Mañana a las cuatro, por favor. Mi nombre es María López. Mi esposo habla inglés; ¿puede confirmar los detalles para él?
transcript.englishTranslation: Tomorrow at four, please. My name is Maria Lopez. My husband speaks English; can you confirm the details for him?

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Of course. Maria is requesting a showing tomorrow at four p.m. for the three-bedroom home on Magnolia Avenue. May I have the best number for confirmation?
transcript.englishTranslation: Of course. Maria is requesting a showing tomorrow at four p.m. for the three-bedroom home on Magnolia Avenue. May I have the best number for confirmation?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.originalText: Yes, it's six six one, five five five, zero one four eight.
transcript.englishTranslation: Yes, it's six six one, five five five, zero one four eight.

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Thank you. I've saved the request and sent it to the agent for confirmation by text. Maria, ¿hay algo más en que pueda ayudarle?
transcript.englishTranslation: Thank you. I've saved the request and sent it to the agent for confirmation by text. Maria, is there anything else I can help you with?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.originalText: No, eso es todo. Gracias.
transcript.englishTranslation: No, that's everything. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Con gusto. Que tengan un excelente día.
transcript.englishTranslation: You're welcome. Have a wonderful day.

demos.title: Merxus Office — Bilingual Call Demo
demos.summary: An office caller reschedules an appointment while Merxus assists a family member in Spanish during the same call.

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Thank you for calling BrightPath Dental. I'm the Merxus AI assistant. How may I help you today?
transcript.englishTranslation: Thank you for calling BrightPath Dental. I'm the Merxus AI assistant. How may I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.originalText: Hi. I need to move my appointment, and my mother has a question in Spanish.
transcript.englishTranslation: Hi. I need to move my appointment, and my mother has a question in Spanish.

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Of course. I can help with both. What day works for your appointment?
transcript.englishTranslation: Of course. I can help with both. What day works for your appointment?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.originalText: Friday morning, if possible. Mom, go ahead.
transcript.englishTranslation: Friday morning, if possible. Mom, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Elena
transcript.originalText: Buenos días. ¿Aceptan nuevos pacientes? También quisiera una cita el viernes.
transcript.englishTranslation: Good morning. Are you accepting new patients? I would also like an appointment on Friday.

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Sí, aceptamos nuevos pacientes. Hay una cita disponible el viernes a las diez y media. ¿Desea solicitarla?
transcript.englishTranslation: Yes, we are accepting new patients. An appointment is available Friday at ten thirty. Would you like to request it?

transcript.speaker: Elena
transcript.originalText: Sí, por favor. Mi nombre es Elena Ramírez.
transcript.englishTranslation: Yes, please. My name is Elena Ramirez.

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Perfecto. He anotado la solicitud para Elena Ramírez. Recibirá la confirmación por mensaje de texto.
transcript.englishTranslation: Perfect. I've recorded the request for Elena Ramirez. You will receive confirmation by text message.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.originalText: And can you move my appointment to eleven?
transcript.englishTranslation: And can you move my appointment to eleven?

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: Yes. I've sent both requests to the office: Elena at ten thirty and your appointment at eleven. The team will confirm by text shortly.
transcript.englishTranslation: Yes. I've sent both requests to the office: Elena at ten thirty and your appointment at eleven. The team will confirm by text shortly.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.originalText: Great, thank you.
transcript.englishTranslation: Great, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Merxus AI
transcript.originalText: You're welcome. Have a great day.
transcript.englishTranslation: You're welcome. Have a great day.
